info.title: agentblazor
info.description: Advanced scaffold and validation tool for wiring AgentBlazor into existing Blazor apps.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze an existing Blazor app and write a read-only markdown report

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --host
options.description:
Name of the Blazor host project
(auto-detected if not specified)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Path to write the markdown report. Defaults
to .agentblazor/analysis.md next to the
solution or project

options.name: --framework
options.description:
Framework override. v1 currently supports
'auto' and 'blazor'

options.name: --no-readiness
options.description:
Skip AgentBlazor install-readiness checks in
the report

options.name: --static-only
options.description:
Skip the LLM workflow suggestion call and
write a static-analysis-only report
project plus project references; 'solution'
scans every project in the solution

options.name: --scan-scope
options.description:
Projects to scan: 'references' scans the host
project plus project references; 'solution'
scans every project in the solution

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Skip interactive prompts and use defaults
